limitations: No independent converged reference or mesh study.
MPC overlap/overconstraint, thin layer mesh and residual force imbalance remain.
Native mixed-element/material warnings concern discretization error estimates; those estimates are not used as accuracy evidence.
Contact/bolt values checked against submitted scripts/logs but not all independently recomputed.
Unqualified displacement maximum is scope-dependent; original-node Mechanical values match raw within 1e-8 mm, but generated cut nodes yield higher extrema.

review_findings.finding: Linux embedding required mechanical-env with installation root; default gRPC lacked certificate.
review_findings.v2: Use the tested embedding wrapper and child-process environment. Do not probe unavailable gRPC after a valid route is established.

review_findings.finding: Broad InternalValue introspection crashed Mechanical and left project locks.
review_findings.v2: Query narrow public APIs; restore through a new imported project and preserve the crashed attempt.

review_findings.finding: Import generated nine unintended contacts; formal solve correctly retained only six specified pairs.
review_findings.v2: Assert the exact active contact set and source/target names before solving.

review_findings.finding: Four-step pretension table needed four values; force-controlled first-step WorkingLoad returned zero reaction.
review_findings.v2: Set step count first, verify Load/Lock in native input; read applied preload in force-control and reaction/working load in locked steps.

review_findings.finding: Embedded JSON was truncated without file close; .NET UInt32 needed conversion.
review_findings.v2: Use context-managed files and explicit Python numeric conversion before serialization.

review_findings.finding: Solver converged but MPC/mesh warnings and approximately 0.15% final-step force imbalance remain; stresses exceed 1.5 GPa in a purely elastic model.
review_findings.v2: Separate nonlinear convergence from force balance, mesh adequacy and strength validity; preserve prescribed contacts and stiffness settings.

review_findings.finding: Mechanical maximum displacement excludes solver-generated pretension-cut nodes. Original-node maximum is 0.393092 mm at step 2, while all solid-element nodes reach 0.403253 mm (about 2.58% higher). The declared global maximum needs a scope qualifier.
review_findings.v2: Define original mesh versus solver-generated cut/auxiliary nodes. Export both scoped maxima and node IDs; distinguish pretension adjustment DOF from structural displacement.
